import json
def greens():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    out=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            # compute cell from boundary bbox
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            r0=min(rs); c0=min(cs)
            # board cell: row 12+6r .. 17+6r
            r=(r0-12)//6; c=(c0-12)//6
            out.append((r,c))
    return sorted(out)
print("greens now:", greens())

action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':33}], intent='explore')
print("after select (1,3):", greens())
# check g-frame location
a = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
gcells=[]
for r in range(12,29):
    for c in range(12,52):
        if a[r][c]=='g':
            gcells.append((r,c))
if gcells:
    rs=[x[0] for x in gcells]; cs=[x[1] for x in gcells]
    print("g-frame bbox:", min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs), "-> cell", ((min(rs)-12)//6,(min(cs)-12)//6))
